Double-click to add to wallet. | type = Consumable | material storage = Advanced Crafting Materials | rarity = Legendary | bound = Account | id = 77302 | status = discontinued | requires = hot, pof, eod }} Consumable [[Legendary Insight (consumable)|Legendary Insight]]s are discontinued items that were previously earnable from [[raid]]s. They can be converted to a new wallet [[currency]] via a double-click or via a service from the merchants and gizmos [[#Currency for|listed]] on this page.
